name: Nomad Bridge
tldr: An upgrade made every message count as valid. Hundreds of copycats drained the bridge by copy-pasting the first attack.
what: Nomad was a bridge that only released funds for messages proven against a trusted root.
happened: After an upgrade, a fake message passed the check. Once the first attacker showed how, anyone could copy the transaction, change the address to their own, and withdraw.
bug: The upgrade set the trusted root to zero, a value that the code then treated as valid for any message.
prevent: Review the configuration values of every upgrade, not just the code, and test that invalid messages still fail.
lesson: An upgrade is new code plus new settings. Audit both.
